macros.name: feasttitle
macros.doc: For typesetting the actual entries in the breviary (as in, individual feast entries), the command \feasttitle is provided.

macros.name: feasttitle
macros.doc: For typesetting the actual entries in the breviary (as in, individual feast entries), the command \feasttitle is provided.

macros.name: greatfeast
macros.doc: This is the command \greatfeast, which is much simpler than the \feasttitle macro. It simply prints, in all caps, the name of the feast in slightly larger type, followed by the class in the normal type.

macros.name: hourheading
macros.doc: Hours themselves (e.g., Matins, Lauds, et cetera) must also be headed, and the command \hourheading provides amply for this need.

macros.name: instruct
macros.doc: \instruct typesets the instructions in a small size (with \small) and in red, as is the general practice.

macros.name: latin
macros.doc: \latin very simply and easily changes the text enclosed in its braces to Latin, typeset according to the guidelines of the ecclesiastic package.

macros.name: lessonheading
macros.doc: \lessonheading prints the simple “Lectio iii” (or whatever text is entered as its one and only argument).

macros.name: markup
macros.doc: By default, \markup produces normal sized text in red.
